sections.title: Industries we serve
sections.text: A shopper searches for a product, a patient for a symptom, an investor for a location. Choose your industry to see how we build pages and content around the way your customers search.

sections.title: Your industry shapes the pages, not just the keywords
sections.text: We start with one question: what does your customer need to decide before getting in touch? The answer shapes the page structure, the content and how we measure results.

items.heading: You sell a product
items.text: Start with category and product pages and your catalog data.

items.heading: You sell a service
items.text: Start with the service page and the questions customers ask before getting in touch.

items.heading: Your customers take time to decide
items.text: Invest in content that compares and explains before the inquiry.

items.heading: Your customers decide locally
items.text: Start with local search and branch and area pages.

items.question: Why does the plan differ from one industry to another?
items.answer: Because search behavior and the decision path differ. An online store relies on its product pages, while a service company relies on its service pages and the content people read before getting in touch.

items.question: What if my business isn't one of the eight industries?
items.answer: The industries listed are the ones we work with most often. We also work with other industries, after reviewing how your customers search and how your site is structured.

items.question: Does the timeline vary by industry?
items.answer: It depends more on the competition, the size of your site and the condition of its pages than on the industry itself.

items.question: Can you cover more than one industry for the same company?
items.answer: Yes, when a company has more than one line of business. We keep the pages and content for each one separate so they don't compete with each other.

items.question: How is the cost determined?
items.answer: It depends on the scope of work, the size of your site and the level of competition. Check our pricing page, then book a call to discuss your case.
